name: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
description: Entra ID confidential-client PKCE flow, Microsoft Graph profile + group fetch, AAD group-to-role mapping, AES-256-GCM stateless session cookie, and a root middleware that protects configured paths while still honouring AUTH_MODE=mock as a dev short-circuit.

questions.prompt: Map AAD group object IDs to application roles?
Path prefixes the middleware should require auth for (comma-separated)?
Session cookie name? (must match auth-mock's session_cookie_name)

checklist: Register an app at https://portal.azure.com > Azure Active Directory > App registrations
Add http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/entra as a Web redirect URI
Add Microsoft Graph API permission: User.Read (delegated)
If using group role mapping: add GroupMember.Read.All (delegated) and grant admin consent
Set AUTH_MODE=real (or unset AUTH_MODE) — this template's middleware.ts overwrites auth-mock's dev middleware and runs real Entra auth on protected paths
Keep AUTH_MODE=mock for local dev — both the middleware and getCurrentUser() short-circuit to MOCK_USER
Verify GET /api/auth/me returns UserContext with correct roles
Verify DELETE /api/auth/logout/entra clears the session cookie
Confirm middleware redirects unauthenticated requests to /api/auth/login/entra for paths under {protected_paths}
Use getCurrentUser() / requireAuth() in Server Components and Server Actions
